The [[Chubbit]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]] led a '''resistance''' to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] occupation of their world during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Chubbits began their activities after the Empire erected the [[Iron Tower]], a massive structure that overcame [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] anomalies in Aridus to allow Imperial [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment to function but which also crippled the Chubbit [[nervous system]] and could even lead to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="CSW10" /> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives aided the Chubbit resistance. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] joined an exhibition that destroyed the Iron Tower in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], for instance.<ref name="CSW11" /> Meanwhile, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Wrenga Jixton]] befriended the Chubbits and made a deal with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to convince the Empire to abandon its operations on Aridus.<ref name="SS" />
